title: Twist-2 at seven loops in planar N=4 SYM theory: full result and analytic properties
claim: Seven-loop general-spin twist-two anomalous dimension from QSC values at fixed spin, reconstructed with the LLL algorithm and modular arithmetic; analytic continuation to negative spin and relation to BFKL/double-log corrections.
scheme: No regularization: not a DR (or any Feynman-graph) computation. Planar spectrum obtained from the integrable AdS5 x S5 worldsheet S-matrix (asymptotic Bethe ansatz with BES/BHL dressing phase) plus finite-size corrections. QSC + LLL/modular reconstruction.

assumed: all-loop integrability of planar N=4 SYM / AdS5 x S5 superstring
asymptotic Bethe ansatz with the BES/BHL dressing phase (exact worldsheet S-matrix)
identification of gauge-theory anomalous dimensions with string energies (AdS/CFT) in the planar limit

red_flags: no general-spin result beyond seven loops found; an eight-loop general-spin twist-two result was not located
notes: Highest loop order for general-spin twist two found: 7 loops (integrability). Konishi (spin 2) itself: 11 loops (S1b.10).
